description: Manage your Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) directory from a workflow: onboard people with a sign-in name and initial password, keep their profile and manager current, block their sign-in or sign them out everywhere when they leave, and manage the security groups that grant access. Deleted users and groups can be restored for 30 days.
